titre: La volaille capte la croissance de la viande
sous_titre: Millions de tonnes de consommation supplémentaire projetée entre 2026 et 2035

Volaille.texte: poultry, accounts by far, for the largest absolute increase in consumption, increasing by 29 Mt (+20%)

Bœuf.texte: beef rises by 6 Mt (+8%), and pig meat by a more modest 6 Mt (+4%)

Porc.texte: pig meat by a more modest 6 Mt (+4%)

Mouton.texte: Sheep meat also grows relatively quickly, rising by 3 Mt (+20%)
